purpose: Long-term average resource-budget constraint using a cost virtual queue and global predictive RL
pricing: Same fixed CPU/GPU-capacity prices in [3,10] as the previous cost experiment; all policies pay the same node prices
selection: Validation budget feasibility first; then SLA-minus-data objective; least violation if none feasible; test frozen before training
scope: No method-specific charges; no price reassignment, deployment, dynamics, reporting, workload or SLA changes
budget_interpretation: The queue uses the conservative internal target 0.87; the contract budget 0.90 was fixed before confirmatory seeds 93000-93002 were evaluated
